nodes.description: Drives the turtle in a square.
nodes.interfaceSummary: Resets the simulator, reads the turtle pose, and publishes velocity commands.
nodes.distributionNote: ROS 2 Jazzy package ros-jazzy-turtlesim. Start the simulator before this node so the reset service is available.

nodes.description: Makes one turtle mimic another.
nodes.interfaceSummary: Reads the source turtle pose and publishes velocity commands to the target turtle.
nodes.distributionNote: ROS 2 Jazzy package ros-jazzy-turtlesim. The default node name is turtle_mimic. Remap input/pose and output/cmd_vel to the source and target turtle topics.

nodes.description: Drives the turtle with keyboard input.
nodes.interfaceSummary: Publishes velocity commands and sends absolute rotation goals.
nodes.distributionNote: ROS 2 Jazzy package ros-jazzy-turtlesim. Requires an interactive terminal. The default node name is teleop_turtle.

nodes.description: Runs the Qt turtle simulator.
nodes.interfaceSummary: Controls the default turtle and exposes its pose, color sensor, and lifecycle controls.
nodes.distributionNote: ROS 2 Jazzy package ros-jazzy-turtlesim. Requires a Qt display. Names under turtle1 also exist for each additional spawned turtle.
